A vast sea of clouds seen from above, the white surface broken by mountain-tops emerging like islands, the air above perfectly clear and blue, a hundred shapes casting moving shadows on the cloud below.
An ancient ruined city spread across a wide plateau, its towers broken and its streets long silted over, every rooftop and parapet serving as a perch, the sky above thick with lazy circles.
A coastal delta where a great river fans into a shallow sea, the mudflats silver in low morning light, reed-islands stretching in every direction, the vast sky over the estuary crowded with shapes.

A high alpine meadow-world above the treeline, cirque lakes reflecting grey cloud, scree-slopes rising to snowfields, the wind constant and strong, dozens of forms using the ridge-crests as launching points.
A deep oceanic trench seen from just above the water, black waves rolling under a moonless night sky, bioluminescence flickering in the depths, the darkness above and below both full of moving forms.

A steppe of endless grass under a vast dome of sky lit by auroras, the grassland flat to the horizon, low volcanic hills in the far distance glowing, the aurora-curtains framing countless silhouettes.

A sky of perpetual golden twilight over a world of floating crystal spires, the spires catching and fracturing the light in every direction, bridges of stone connecting them, every platform and ledge occupied.

A ridge of black sea-stacks rising from a boiling inlet, waves exploding against their bases, the tops flat and wide, the cliff-faces streaked white, the whole formation buried in wheeling, crying shapes.
A high-altitude river canyon of red sandstone, the river a silver thread miles below, the canyon walls in tiers of ledges and alcoves, warm updrafts rising steadily, forms gliding on every thermal.

A world-edge escarpment where the land simply ends in a sheer cliff dropping into bottomless cloud, the plateau behind stretching flat and dark, the updraft from the cliff-face constant, lifting everything skyward.

A vast volcanic mountain range smoking beneath a blood-red sky, lava rivers glowing in the valleys far below, jagged peaks marching to a hazy horizon — ample churning sky for a whole flock circling above.
Towering sea-cliffs plunging into a churning grey ocean, the rock honeycombed with roost-ledges, sea-spray and mist rising in curtains, storm-clouds boiling overhead with room for dozens aloft.
A colossal ancient dragon-mountain honeycombed with cave-roosts, smoke and dragon-shapes pouring endlessly from its openings, the enormous peak lost in cloud far above, the flanks alive with wings.

A stormy sky of towering thunderheads split by lightning, the clouds stacked in vast purple mountains from horizon to horizon, wind-shear and updrafts filling every layer with wheeling dark silhouettes.

A blazing sunset sky above an endless patchwork landscape of forests, rivers, and plains far below, the heavens burning orange and crimson, deep enough for an entire brood spiraling in the warm thermals.

A frozen peak-range of blue glaciers and white summits stretching endlessly, ice-caves glowing turquoise within the cliffs, bitter wind kicking snow-plumes off the ridges, pale sky above filled with circling shapes.
A great canyon of red-stone spires dropping to a shadowed river far below, the walls riddled with ledges and caves, wind howling between the pillars, the open column of air thick with soaring wings.

The skies above a besieged fantasy city at night, towers burning, siege-fires dotting the plains beyond, smoke columns rising into a lurid orange overcast while dark shapes wheel and dive in enormous numbers overhead.
